response.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) AS total_g_minus_l, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w > 26;

assumptions.assumption: The total is the sum of the per-record difference (g - l). Records where g or l is NULL give a NULL difference, and SUM skips them. The record count still counts every manager_half row with w > 26, including any with a NULL g or l.
